purpose: Phase-8A resistance-response modifier. The single ADVISORY output the resistance engine hands to subsequent response stages: a set of bounded modifiers (exposure/uptake/target effectiveness, stress/apoptosis sensitivity, population loss, recovery/regrowth pressure, durability, net treatment sensitivity). Every modifier is bounded and applied ADDITIVELY through explicit adapters; NONE mutates raw state owned by a previous engine. Schematic normalized only.

coefficient_policy.0_interpretation: 0 = maximal resistance effect (e.g. treatment sensitivity fully suppressed for that channel)
coefficient_policy.source: derived from resistance burden + per-mechanism states (predicted)
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: net_treatment_sensitivity_modifier is the headline advisory value consumed next frame; component modifiers feed their matching adapters.
coefficient_policy.limitations: Advisory only; no measured efficacy change (NOT_REPORTED quantitatively).

net_combination.note: net_treatment_sensitivity_modifier = clamp(product of the effectiveness channels adjusted by burden, floor, 1); a single bounded advisory value. Applied next frame, never to the same response event that created it.

rules.additive_adapters_only: Modifiers are consumed by resistance* adapters that return bounded modifiers; they never write into upstream engine state.
rules.temporal_separation: Modifiers are stored on frame N and consumed on frame N+1 (or the approved subsequent response stage); no same-stage causal loop.
